## 🌙 Our intention (النية)

Faqih exists to help every Muslim, young or old, Arab or non-Arab, come closer to the Book of Allah. We build it as sadaqah jariyah: free, authentic, and made with adab.

The Prophet ﷺ said: _"The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it."_ (Bukhari)

**Faqih (فقيه)** means "one who has deep understanding". The name recalls the hadith: _"Whoever Allah wants good for, He gives him understanding of the religion."_ (Bukhari & Muslim)

This board is where the team plans, builds, reviews and launches that work: code, content and scholarly review.

---

## 👥 Who we serve

| Learner | What Faqih gives them |
| --- | --- |
| 🧒 **Children** | Gentle lessons with no hearts or penalties, big buttons, read aloud by a qari, short surahs and authentic stories of the Prophet ﷺ and the Sahabah. Parent-managed, no child accounts. |
| 🧑 **Adults** | Daily practice to memorise and revise the whole Quran, from Juz Amma to the full mushaf, with exams per surah and a hifz review queue. |
| 🕌 **Arabic speakers** | An Arabic, right-to-left interface by default, Uthmani script, and lenient typed answers (no diacritics needed). |
| 🌍 **Non-Arabic speakers** | An English interface one tap away, meaning of each ayah, listen-and-pick exercises, and a path from hearing the Quran to reading it. More languages (Urdu, Indonesian, Turkish, French) are planned. |

---

## 🕋 Principles (our adab)

Every card on this board must respect these. If a task conflicts with one, raise it before starting.

| Principle | In practice |
| --- | --- |
| **Islamic first** | The Quran and Sunnah lead every decision. Design, wording, sounds and rewards must suit the honour of the Quran. |
| **Free knowledge** | No paywall on learning. Payments stay off; donations may come later. |
| **Authentic and reviewed** | Every item cites its source (surah:ayah, or hadith reference with grading). Nothing goes live until a qualified reviewer approves it. |
| **The Quran is never altered** | Wrong answers are always other real ayat or words. No made-up or edited Quran text, ever. |
| **Recited, never synthesised** | Quran audio comes only from a qari (al-Husary _muallim_ for kids, Alafasy otherwise). |
| **Gentle motivation** | No "lose a life" on memorisation. Leaderboards are opt-in. Encouragement over punishment. |
| **Authentic stories only** | Sound reports only, with source and grading recorded. Popular but weak stories are left out. |
| **Easy access** | Short daily lessons, guest mode with no sign-up, mobile first, works on slow connections. |

---

## 📚 Learning paths

| Path | Content | Exercises |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🧒 **Kids** | Al-Fatiha and the last 10 surahs, stories of the Prophet ﷺ and the Sahabah, facts about the Prophet ﷺ | Listen and repeat, order the words, complete the word, story quiz, true or false |
| 📖 **Full Quran (Hifz)** | All 114 surahs and 6,236 ayat from the Tanzil text, with difficulty levels | Complete the word, complete the ayah, listen and pick, ayah order, recite |
| 🎙️ **Tajweed** | Core rules: noon sakinah and tanween, meem sakinah, madd, qalqalah and more | Spot the rule, listen and pick, match rule to example |

### 🏆 Coming later: Maher mode (وضع الماهر)

Named after the hadith: _"The one who is skilled (الماهر) in the Quran will be with the noble, righteous scribes (angels)."_ (Bukhari & Muslim)

Maher mode is a challenge mode for learners who want to test and deepen what they know:

- **Quran challenges:** continue the ayah, name the surah, find the ayah number, which juz is this in, timed revision runs.
- **Islamic knowledge challenges:** Sirah, the Prophets, the Sahabah, adhkar, pillars of Islam and iman, and Quranic vocabulary.
- **Levels and badges** that reward mastery, not speed alone, with opt-in friendly competition between family and friends.
- **Same adab rules:** sourced and reviewed questions, and no altered Quran text.

Also planned: Hadith (beyond an-Nawawi 1 to 10), Sirah, Quranic Arabic vocabulary, a fiqh "Faqih level", recitation feedback, a native app and a reviewer CMS.

## 🗂️ How we use this board

### Status

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **📥 Backlog** | An idea or request, not yet scoped. |
| **📝 Ready** | Scoped, with acceptance criteria. Anyone can pick it up. |
| **🏗️ In progress** | Assigned and being worked on. Keep it to 2 cards per person at most. |
| **👀 Code review** | A PR is open and linked to the card. |
| **📿 Scholarly review** | Content is built and waits for sign-off from a qualified reviewer. |
| **✅ Done** | Merged to `main`, and for content, marked `reviewed`. |

### Fields

- **Phase:** M0 to M7 · Later
- **Path:** Kids · Full Quran · Tajweed · Maher · Hadith and Sirah · Platform
- **Audience:** Kids · Adults · Arabic speakers · Non-Arabic speakers · All learners
- **Work type:** Feature · Content · Review · Decision
- **Priority:** P0 (blocker) · P1 (this phase) · P2 (nice to have)
- **Size:** S · M · L
- **Start date** and **Target date:** used by the Roadmap view

The board is kept in the repo: edit `.github/project/items.json` (or this README) in a pull request, and the **Sync project board info** action updates the board when it is merged.

### Before a card is Ready

- [ ] Clear title: verb plus thing (e.g. "Add repeat-N-times audio for kids")
- [ ] Phase, Path, Audience, Work type, Priority and Size set
- [ ] Acceptance criteria ("done when...")
- [ ] For content: the source (surah:ayah, hadith with grading, or book)
- [ ] For UI: check Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), and kids mode

### Definition of done

- Merged to `main` with lint and format passing (`bun run lint`, `bun run format`).
- Checked in Arabic and English, on mobile, in kids and full mode.
- Content shows its source and is marked `reviewed` only after reviewer sign-off.
- Schema changes are safe for the database action; anything destructive is flagged on the card.
- Docs updated if behaviour changed.

## 🛠️ Tech

Next.js 16 · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Drizzle ORM · Neon Postgres · Clerk · Zustand · Bun 1.3.4

Quick start: copy `.env.example` to `.env`, then run `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `bun run db:push`, `bun run content:import` and `bun run dev`. Details in [docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md).

---

## ⚠️ Risks we watch

| Risk | How we handle it |
| --- | --- |
| Content errors or weak sources | Reviewer sign-off, a source on every item, a "report a correction" button |
| Licensing of text, audio and tajweed data | Openly licensed sources only, an attribution page, licences tracked per source |
| Slow content production | Generate Quran exercises from the text, start with Juz Amma, recruit volunteers |
| Games that clash with reverence | The adab rules above, mechanics reviewed with scholars |
| Children's privacy | No child accounts, on-device or parent-managed progress, minimal data |
